reels.title: FocusVTC: Efficient and High-Performance Visual Text Compression with Adaptive Resolution

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper leverages the highest-performing category (multimodal_diffusion/visual) and addresses hardware efficiency, hitting two high-growth multipliers. It tackles the massive, relatable problem of LLMs 'slowing down' by compressing visual text, which is an intuitive topic for non-specialists.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI assistant could 'read' a book just by looking at a photo of it?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Comparing a high-resolution, bulky textbook to a shorthand cheat-sheet that retains all the critical information while being significantly faster to scan.
